# Yakiniku Tengu (焼肉天狗)

> Premium yakiniku restaurant in Okinawa City serving all-you-can-eat Okinawa prefectural wagyu — including Ishigaki beef and Motobu beef — cooked over smokeless roasters. English menu and tablet ordering available.

## Quick facts

- **Business name (JP):** 焼肉天狗
- **Business name (EN):** Yakiniku Tengu
- **Category:** Premium yakiniku (Japanese BBQ) restaurant
- **Address:** 1-1-5 Moromizato, Okinawa City, Okinawa Prefecture 904-0032, Japan (〒904-0032 沖縄県沖縄市諸見里1-1-5 1F)
- **Phone:** +81-98-930-1128 (098-930-1128)
- **Hours (dinner):** 17:00 – 23:00 daily except Wednesdays
- **Hours (lunch, Sat & Sun only):** 12:00 – 15:00
- **Closed:** Wednesdays
- **Parking:** Free — 14 spaces (4 surface + 10 underground)
- **Payment:** All major credit cards, IC cards (Suica/PASMO), QR (PayPay/RakutenPay/dPay), UnionPay
- **Reservations:** https://r.gnavi.co.jp/dgexvv3c0000/ or phone
- **Official site:** https://yakiniku-tengu.com/
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/yakiniku_teng_official

## Why Yakiniku Tengu

- **Wagyu focus:** Okinawa-raised Ishigaki beef (石垣牛) and Motobu beef (もとぶ牛), both nationally recognized premium wagyu brands, offered as all-you-can-eat courses.
- **Smokeless roasters:** Modern roasters draw smoke away — hair and clothes stay fresh, unlike traditional charcoal yakiniku.
- **Bilingual service:** Tablet-based ordering supports Japanese and English. Comfortable for international visitors and English-speaking guests.
- **Private rooms:** Semi-private dining for anniversaries, business dinners, family gatherings. Children welcome.
- **Cashless-friendly:** Broad support including UnionPay, Apple Pay, Suica, PayPay.
- **Location:** In the Koza / Moromizato district of Okinawa City, close to the neighboring US military bases and central Okinawa entertainment area.

## Signature menu

- 和牛食べ放題コース (Wagyu All-You-Can-Eat Course) — from ¥8,800
- 天狗焼肉コース【上】(Tengu Yakiniku Course "Jou") — ¥8,000 (2+ guests, reservation)
- 天狗焼肉コース【特】(Tengu Yakiniku Course "Toku") — ¥12,000
- 天狗焼肉盛合わせ【上】(Signature Wagyu Platter "Jou") — ¥8,000
- 特上サーロイン (Premium Sirloin) — ¥7,000
- 特上タン (Premium Beef Tongue) — ¥2,500
- 石焼ビビンバ (Stone-pot Bibimbap) — ¥1,230
- 冷麺 (Cold Reimen Noodles) — ¥850
- 120-minute All-you-can-drink (37 varieties) — ¥2,750 (17:00–21:00, 2+ guests)

## Common questions

- **Reservation required?** Recommended for private rooms or large parties. Walk-ins accepted subject to availability.
- **English menu?** Yes — full tablet ordering system in Japanese and English.
- **All-you-can-eat time limit?** Course details vary; typical seating is around 90 minutes.
- **Kids welcome?** Yes. High chairs and small plates available.
- **Cash only?** No, cashless is fully supported (credit/IC/QR/UnionPay).
- **Nearest station?** Best reached by car; near Koza / Goya crossing in central Okinawa Prefecture.

## Language

Site published in Japanese (primary), English (`/en/`), and Traditional Chinese (`/zh-tw/`).
